## Introduction

In this notebook, we are reverse engineering the story, 'Thousands of kids are missing from school. Where did they go?' from the Associated Press.

## Load libraries

Loading required libraries for this analysis.

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(janitor)
```

## Load and Cleaning Data

In this section, describe the source of the data, write a basic data dictionary for data you are working with, and discuss any caveats or issues you discovered working with this data.

```{r}
# Load required data
age_population <- read.csv("data/population-by-age.csv")|> 
  clean_names()
  
public_enrollment <- read.csv("data/public-enrollment-by-grade.csv")|>
  clean_names()|>
  rename(state_abrev = "st")|>
  rename(public_enrollment = "enrollment")

private_enrollment <- read.csv("data/private-enrollment-by-grade.csv")|>
  clean_names()|>
  rename(state_abrev = "state")|>
  rename(private_enrollment = "enrollment")
  
# New combined dataset
school_story <- public_enrollment |>
  full_join(private_enrollment, join_by(fips, sch_year, grade, state_abrev))|>
  filter(fips %in% c (6, 36, 22, 37, 58, 8, 13, 27, 55, 33, 25, 30, 10, 38, 11, 46, 45, 31,44, 47, 42, 12))
```

## Sentences to Engineer

In this notebook, we are reverse engineering five sentences from the story.

### Sentence 1

- **Sentence text**: “The population of school-age kids in the states we studied fell by about 183,000, according to census estimates.”

-  **Summary**: Our results confirmed the AP's claim stating that the population of school-age kids in the 22 states studied fell by about 183,000. We found this number by finding the difference between the provided age and population data from July 2020 to the age and population data we have found from 2021.

  ```{r}

  age_2020_pop <- age_population|>
    mutate(year = year(est_date), month = month(est_date))|>
    filter(year == 2020 & month == 4)|>
    filter(fips %in% c (6, 36, 22, 37, 58, 8, 13, 27, 55, 33, 25, 30, 10, 38, 11, 46, 45, 31,44, 47, 42, 12))|>
    group_by(state)|>
    summarise(total_pop_2020 = sum(population))


  age_2021_pop <- age_population|>
    mutate(year = year(est_date), month = month(est_date))|>
    filter(year == 2021 & month == 7)|>
    filter(fips %in% c (6, 36, 22, 37, 58, 8, 13, 27, 55, 33, 25, 30, 10, 38, 11, 46, 45, 31,44, 47, 42, 12))|>
    group_by(state)|>
    summarise(total_pop_2021 = sum(population))


  combo_age_year <- age_2021_pop|>
    left_join(age_2020_pop, join_by(state))|>
    mutate(difference = total_pop_2020 - total_pop_2021)|>
    summarise(total_difference = sum(difference))
  ```
